summary: Old Republic International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $700M offering of 5.700% senior notes due 2036 at 99.974% of par, yielding ~$695M net proceeds after underwriting discount. The notes are senior unsecured, redeemable make-whole prior to March 2036. Joint book-running managers are Morgan Stanley and PNC Capital Markets. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No deal terms apply as this is a standard capital markets transaction.
